lead_in: Philemon 8–17: the Catholic Encyclopedia on Josaphat, martyred at Vitebsk, who served souls in the fields, hospitals and prisons.

excerpt.text: Finally on 12 November, 1623, an axe-stroke and a bullet brought Josaphat his martyr’s crown. . . . As deacon, priest, and bishop, he was distinguished by his extraordinary zeal in the service of souls. Not alone in the church did he preach and hear confessions, but likewise in the fields, hospitals, prisons, and even on his journeys.
